english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to say that someone does something loudly or at a high volume.

examples.english: You don't need to speak loudly; I can hear you.
examples.traditional: 你唔使大聲咁講，我聽到㗎。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 daai6 seng1 gam3 gong2 ngo5 teng1 dou2 gaa3
